## Approach

ADVISORY model work. This is a one-line doc-comment edit in one file, with no behaviour change.

Live state read this run (`features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`): the doc comment on `getProfileData` (lines
52-58) ends with the line
`* TODO: Add organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md).` (line 57). The function
is `export async function getProfileData(userId: string): Promise<ProfileData>`: one parameter, an E2E fixture branch
on `env.NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_MSW === E2E_MSW_ENABLED`, then the parallel `user` / `user_profiles` reads. A search of
`features/profile/` finds no other line containing "TODO", and no other occurrence of "multi-workspace support".

The build replaces that one TODO line with one sentence, keeping the comment's ~80-column wrapping and the blank
` *` line above it:

```ts
 * The profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no
 * organization id.
```

The first paragraph of the comment, the signature, the body and every other file stay byte-for-byte as they are.

## Applied lessons

- none — the project has no memory-bank yet (`check-lessons-index.mjs --verdict` printed `NO_CANON`), so there is no
  lesson to apply.

## Steps

- In `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`, replace only line 57 (the TODO line) of `getProfileData`'s doc comment
  with the two-line wrapped sentence shown in the Approach. Leave lines 52-56 and 58 (the opening `/**`, the first
  paragraph, the blank ` *` line and the closing `*/`) unchanged, along with the function itself.
- Do not edit `features/profile/services/__tests__/get-profile.test.ts` (SPEC constraint).
- Run `npx prettier --check features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`, then `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`
  and `npm run test`. The edit is inside a comment, so none of them should change.

## Files

- `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` — replace the stale TODO line in `getProfileData`'s doc comment with the one sentence saying the profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id

  must keep passing unchanged (AC-3)

- `docs/architecture/profile.md` — docs are out of scope

## Acceptance mapping

- AC-1 (no "multi-workspace support" anywhere under `features/profile/`, and no line holding both "TODO" and
  "organizationId") → the only matching line, line 57 of `get-profile.ts`, is removed. The AC test walks every file
  under `features/profile/` recursively, its own file included. It must therefore build its two needles from fragments
  (e.g. `["multi-workspace", "support"].join(" ")`, `"TO" + "DO"`) and never hold a line that has both literal words,
  so that it does not match itself.
- AC-2 (the doc comment directly above the `getProfileData` export says the profile is per person, not per workspace,
  and that `getProfileData` takes no organization id) → the new sentence. The AC test reads `get-profile.ts` as text
  and takes the last `/** … */` block before `export async function getProfileData`, with only whitespace between the
  `*/` and the export. It strips each line's leading `*` and collapses whitespace, so the two-line wrap reads as one
  sentence, then asserts the text matches `/the profile is per person, not per workspace/i` and
  ``/`?getProfileData`? takes no organization id/i``.
- AC-3 (existing `getProfileData` tests pass unchanged, including the E2E fixture case, and `getProfileData.length`

- AC-1 self-match: an AC test file under `features/profile/` that holds the needles literally would fail AC-1 against
  itself. `/pharn-test` must build the needles from fragments (see the mapping above).
- AC-3's "test file unchanged" cannot be observed by a unit test. It holds because the existing test file is not in
  this plan's `## Files`, so the build's writes-scope never covers it, and because `/pharn-regress` compares the suite

- The sentence wraps over two comment lines to match the file's style. AC-2's test must normalize comment whitespace

## Intent

The profile service that assembles a person's profile data still carries a stale TODO in its doc comment:
"TODO: Add organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". Workspaces have
existed for months, the profile page is personal-only by decision, the profile read covers only one person's own
user and profile records, and the project instructions say nothing about such a parameter. A reader of that
comment, human or agent, is told to plan for a workspace parameter that the product has decided against.

The owner wants the TODO replaced by one doc-comment sentence that states the actual rule: the profile is per
person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id. Nothing else changes.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Remove the stale TODO about an organizationId parameter and "multi-workspace support" from the doc comment of
  `getProfileData` in the profile feature module.
- Add one sentence to that doc comment stating that the profile is per person, not per workspace, so
  `getProfileData` takes no organization id.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any behaviour change to `getProfileData`: its signature, its return value and its E2E fixture branch stay exactly
  as they are.
- Any change to the rest of the doc comment, to other files of the profile module, or to the profile page.
- Editing the existing profile unit tests.
- Any change to project instructions, docs or other feature modules.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the source files under `features/profile/` When every file is searched for the text
  "multi-workspace support", and every line is checked for both "TODO" and "organizationId" Then no file contains
  "multi-workspace support" and no line contains both "TODO" and "organizationId"
  - verify: unit
- **AC-2** Given the profile service source that exports `getProfileData` When the doc comment directly above its
  export is read Then that comment contains a sentence saying the profile is per person, not per workspace, and that
  `getProfileData` takes no organization id
  - verify: unit
- **AC-3** Given the existing unit tests for `getProfileData` in the profile services test suite, with that test
  file unchanged When the suite runs Then every existing test passes, including the E2E fixture case, and
  `getProfileData` still declares exactly one parameter
  - verify: unit

## Constraints

- No behaviour change: `getProfileData`'s parameter list, return value and E2E fixture branch are unchanged.
- The existing profile unit test file is not edited.
- The replacement is a single doc-comment sentence.

## Assumptions

- The project's `test` script (`vitest run`) is the runner for all three criteria; AC-1 and AC-2 are observable by a
  unit test that reads the source text as a returned value.
- "A TODO about an organizationId parameter" is read as any line under `features/profile/` containing both "TODO" and
  "organizationId"; today only the one doc-comment line in the profile service matches.
- The "personal-only by decision" reference to `pharn/features/profile-personal-only` is context only; the rule the new
  sentence states rests on the live code, where `getProfileData` takes only a user id and reads that person's user and
  profile records.
- "Declares exactly one parameter" in AC-3 means the function's declared parameter count (its `length`) is 1, the
  user id it takes today.
